detailed_description: This PDF to Text tool extracts embedded text from PDF files in your browser using PDF.js. It reads each page, joins the text items into plain text, and adds a simple page marker before each page so multi-page output is easier to scan. After extraction, you can copy the text to the clipboard or download it as a .txt file. It is best suited for digital PDFs that already contain selectable text. Scanned PDFs or image-only pages may require separate OCR software before meaningful text can be extracted.
usage_steps: 1. Drag-and-drop a PDF file into the upload area or click the area to choose a file
2. Wait while the browser loads the PDF and extracts text from each page
3. Review the extracted plain text with page markers in the output box
4. Copy the extracted text to the clipboard if you need to paste it elsewhere
5. Download the result as a .txt file when you want to save a local copy
usage_examples: Example 1: A researcher extracts selectable text from a PDF article for note-taking
Example 2: A student converts a digital handout into plain text for easier quoting
Example 3: A support agent copies text from a PDF manual into a knowledge-base draft
Example 4: An office worker saves text from a multi-page PDF as a .txt file with page markers

faqs.question: Does it work with scanned PDFs?
faqs.answer: This tool extracts embedded text from PDFs. For scanned images, you may need OCR software.

faqs.question: Is there a file size limit?
faqs.answer: Processing happens in your browser, so very large files may be slow. We recommend files under 50MB.
